title: IC-GNN: Modeling Individualized Brain Community Organization for Disease Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.13070v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Brain networks exhibit modular organization, where community structures vary substantially across individuals and diseases. Understanding these individual differences is crucial for advancing both basic neuroscience research and precision medicine. However, widely used predefined group-level brain atlases often overlook this heterogeneity. While individualized functional parcellations capture subject-specific variability in community boundaries, they often require lengthy scan times to achieve fine-grained resolution and complicate cross-subject comparisons. To address this trade-off and investigate how individualized community organization captures disease-associated changes across individuals, we propose IC-GNN, an atlas-anchored model that forms distinct, individualized functional communities directly over atlas-defined brain regions. translated_title: IC-GNN：为疾病预测建模个体化的大脑社区组织
translated_abstract: 大脑网络表现出模块化组织，其中社区结构在个体之间以及不同疾病之间存在显著差异。理解这些个体差异对于推进基础神经科学研究和精准医学都至关重要。然而，广泛使用的预定义群体水平脑图谱往往忽略了这种异质性。虽然个体化功能分区能够捕捉受试者特异的社区边界变异，但它们通常需要较长的扫描时间才能达到细粒度分辨率，并且使跨受试者的比较变得复杂。为了解决这种权衡问题，并研究个体化社区组织如何捕捉与疾病相关的个体间变化，我们提出了IC-GNN，这是一种以图谱为锚点的模型，可以直接在图谱定义的脑区之上形成独特的、个体化的功能社区。IC-GNN从静息态功能磁共振成像中推导出离散的、个体化的多尺度社区。
tldr: 提出了一种以图谱为锚点的图神经网络模型IC-GNN，能直接在图谱定义的脑区上构建个体化的多尺度大脑功能社区，从而捕捉与疾病相关的个体间差异并用于疾病预测。
en_tdlr: IC-GNN is an atlas-anchored graph neural network that derives discrete, individualized multiscale functional communities directly over atlas-defined brain regions, capturing disease-related inter-individual variability for disease prediction.
